notes.title: HotFixes v1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Just a small, freshly-brewed hotfix to make your 'Single Espresso' experience even smoother.

[h3]Fixes & Refinements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tidy Menus:[/b] We've realigned the menu header text. Everything should look neat and tidy now!
[*] [b]No More Invisible Characters:[/b] Fixed a tricky bug where characters would sometimes play hide-and-seek in Challenge Mode. They've promised to stay put now! 😉
[/list]

[h3]A Special Thanks![/h3]
[list]
[*] A massive shoutout to [b]Aaron McMullan[/b] for being an absolute star! Your great advice and help in pinpointing these issues were invaluable. Thank you! ✨
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update v1.1 is ready ! ☕
notes.notes:
Get ready, Espresso Aficionados! Major Update v1.1 has landed, and it's brewing with improvements designed to make your 'Single Espresso' experience smoother and more rewarding than ever!

[h2]The "All Challenges Completed" Achievement is now Brewing Correctly! (finally!!) [/h2]
The bug that prevents users from earning the "All Challenges Completed" achievement is fixed. I sincerely apologise to everyone, starting with Amarei and Dragoncuali for pointing out the issue first-hand and also, 大溪地野生泰迪熊, Honorificabilitudinitatibus!!, Sonyeo, Xythe. It took me a while to fix it, thank you very much for your understanding ✨

[h2]Gameplay and Visual updates[/h2]
-Score requirements to earn stars on story mode are balanced. It was fair before, but now it is even more fair!
-Icons that have incorrect resolutions are replaced.
-Overlapping UI elements orders are updated correctly. I like a dash of chaos, but when it comes to UI, it might be better to have some order :)

[h2]Leaderboard removed from Challenge Mode[/h2]
Reason 1, Simplicity: Single Espresso will hopefully be published on multiple platforms soon and it will be hard to maintain a common leaderboard on multiple platforms.
Reason 2, Cost Handling: Unfortunately, Single Espresso was cracked and +20k cracked users downloaded and played since the release date. It was bringing a lot of extra cost in handling the leaderboard and server.

I can't wait for you to dive in and experience the changes! Please let me know what you think 😊

notes.title: Mac support is ready!
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch 1 Details[/h2]
This patch focuses primarily on performance and quality-of-life improvements. Also, we are very happy to announce that Singe Espresso is available on Mac devices.

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]
Fixes for several sources of framerate hitching for smoother gameplay.
Framerate improvements for various hardware configurations.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
Objectives for each challenge level are shown clearly with a bar.
Badge panel visuals and backgrounds are adjusted.
Missing characters on various fonts are fixed.
Main menu visuals redesigned.
